correctness.rationale: Full cube matching complex face vector (12,42,44,9), signed boundary ranks (11,31,9) and previously known wedge4 S2 are consistent. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 4096 induced vertex sets gives mod2 H2-supported counts by size 8:6,9:24,10:42,11:12,12:1, none <=7. The six 8-vertex sets complement precisely six nonparallel cube perfect matchings. The displayed 4 free-face collapses leave an 8-vertex 18-edge 12-triangle closed connected surface with vertex-cycle links and Euler characteristic 2, so S2; full cube symmetries permute all six. The submitted Smith-unit matrix certificate (9 ∂3 columns plus 4 carrier cycles, rank13 all unit factors) ensures integral generation of H2=Z4, stronger than rational or mod2 spanning. Independent full 48-element automorphism Lefschetz computation confirms S4 class traces (4,0,0,1,2) and antipodal-composed (2,−2,−2,−1,0), giving even Specht(2,1,1) and odd trivial one-dimensional piece. SNF part inspected in source algorithm, not independently rerun.
